task.title: Find a profile by name
task.shortdesc: Use Library search to narrow saved profiles by name before opening, duplicating, or changing lifecycle state.

prereq.p: The Profile Library is open and profile rows have finished loading.

context.p: Search narrows the current Library view. It works together with schema, lifecycle, validation, and sort controls.

step.cmd: Place the cursor in the Library search field.

info.p: Expected result: the current row list remains visible while you type.

step.cmd: Enter a distinctive part of the profile name.

info.p: The filtered count updates to match the rows still visible.

step.cmd: Confirm the row identity before choosing an action.

info.note: Search does not save or change profiles. It only changes what the Library shows.

result.p: The Library shows only rows that match the search text and any active filters.

postreq.p: Recovery: clear the search text if the expected profile is missing, then refresh if the row still does not appear.
